introduction: Ohio Legal Help offers legal information, forms and connections to local assistance. Start promptly if a notice or court paper has a deadline.
description: Ohio Legal Help offers legal information, forms and connections to local assistance. Start promptly if a notice or court paper has a deadline.

sections.who: The information is available online. Legal-aid organizations screen applicants separately for service area, issue, eligibility and capacity.
sections.get: You can read topic guides, find legal-aid intake and use available self-help tools. A website visit does not mean a lawyer represents you.
sections.docs:
• Court papers and notices.
  • Lease, payment records or benefit decision relevant to the problem.
  • Household information requested during legal-aid screening.
sections.apply:
1. Choose your issue

    Use Ohio Legal Help to find the relevant topic.

  2. Locate intake

    Answer the questions at Find your legal aid.

  3. Explain deadlines

    Tell the intake organization any hearing or response date and ask what assistance it can provide.
sections.after: Keep track of deadlines while waiting. Ask whether your case has actually been accepted before relying on representation.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Ohio Legal Help; Find legal aid. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Does reading a guide create representation?
No. Confirm acceptance directly with the lawyer or organization.
Can the site help me locate legal aid?
Yes. It has a location and issue screening tool.
What should I bring to intake?
The notices and records connected to your legal problem.
What if I have a hearing soon?
State the date immediately when requesting help.
